title: The King's Chamber as an acoustic catalyst chamber
summary: Geoffrey Drumm tells of The King's Chamber as an acoustic catalyst chamber, about dynastic Egypt at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So the king's chamber and the anti chamber within the great pyramid are acoustic catalyst chambers that catalyze the chemical reaction between sulfur dioxide and oxygen into sulfur triioxide to produce sulfuric acid.

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says that the King's Chamber and the small room before it inside the Great Pyramid in Egypt were acoustic catalyst chambers, rooms that used sound to speed up a chemical reaction. According to him, they turned sulfur dioxide and oxygen into sulfur trioxide to make sulfuric acid. If true, the pyramid would have been a chemical plant rather than a tomb.
